MeasuredUnitRound:
∃ scan : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) scan ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (known : List PEqualNP.Search.Literal),
        scan (known.flatMap PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
          (φ.flatMap (fun c => c.filter (fun l =>
            c.all (fun m => decide (m = l) || decide (PEqualNP.Search.negLit m ∈ known))))).flatMap PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral
MeasuredRUP:
∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause),
        test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = true ↔
          PEqualNP.Search.IsRUP {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ x ∈ φ, x.toFinset = d} c.toFinset
MeasuredRUPRun:
∃ test : List Bool × List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool test ∧
      ∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ) = true ↔
        PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset)
ExactRUPRefutationVerifier:
PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair
      {p : List Bool × List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = p.2 ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) ∧
        [] ∈ ρ} ∧
    (∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
      PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) →
      [] ∈ ρ → ¬PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
BoundedRUPRefutationsInNP:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ).length ≤ q.eval x.length ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) ∧
      [] ∈ ρ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP
RUPCoverageCoNP:
∀ (G : Language Bool) (hG : G ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P) (q : Polynomial ℕ)
    (coverage : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → ¬PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ →
      ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ).length ≤ q.eval (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map fun c => c.toFinset) ∧
        [] ∈ ρ),
    (PEqualNP.Search.SAT ⊓ G) ∈ PEqualNP.Library.coNP
ExactUnitRefutableCNF:
{x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.IsRUP {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} ∅} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
HornUnitRefutation:
∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (hHorn : ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1),
    ¬PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ ↔
      PEqualNP.Search.IsRUP {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} ∅
